_comment: Permission rules install.sh adds to .permissions.ask in ~/.claude/settings.json, so Claude Code asks before it edits a directory brain-stem manages. Those directories are replaced on every upgrade (an edited file is set aside as a .foundation-local sidecar), so a change made there by hand does not last. One rule per managed top-level directory, and one per shipped skill under skills/. Each rule is offered once: the offered set is recorded in governance/.installed-state.json, so a rule you remove is never added back, and a rule a later release adds is offered on that upgrade. Your own allow, deny, ask and defaultMode entries are never removed, rewritten or reordered; the seeded rules are appended after them.
